title: Maffeo da Treviglio to Tamás Bakócz, Milan 30 Nov 1490 (MNL OL DL 46150): the Sforza-Corvinus marriage and the dowry, four pages in cipher

documents.shelfmark: MNL OL DL 46150 (Q 10, Veghely; Hungaricana charters 228061; catalogue 1235)
documents.route: Milan -> Tamás Bakócz, bishop of Győr, chancellor of Hungary (Latin original, closing and address in clear)

plaintext.source: Clear minute of the same letter: ASMi Carteggio Sforzesco 642, novembre no. 8 (Vestigia document 194, vestigia.hu), transcribed in reading/clear_minute.txt; the cipher follows the corrected minute.

transcription.source: Hungaricana charter 228061 images (orig_1 p. 1, orig_2 pp. 2-3, orig_3 p. 4) supplied by the user
transcription.notes: Claude agents from 2-3x crops; shape-only split passes (q, g, oo, h, 8, 6) and two rounds of image repairs. 41 isolated disagreements with the minute listed in transcription/suspects.md, not yet checked on the image. Length: p1-p4.txt together (docs/_check_profile.py --measure on the four files joined, labels and clear brackets dropped): 3,185 legible tokens + 14 lost (??) = 3,199; 76 labels.

system.summary: Homophonic Latin cipher of letter-like signs and figures (about 60 signs carrying text), with polyphonic u/s/f signs, signs for doubled letters (ss, ll, mm, cc, tt, dd), code signs for titles and common words (the king, the duke, Maiestas sua, affinitas, non, quod, quoniam, 150,000) and nulls; no word division.
system.notes: Not Maffeo's 1489 key R5411 (buda1489): a different alphabet. The second Maffeo key R5407 (ASMi cart. 1597 no. 107, 'A = ⊥') agrees on that one known value (⊥ = a here, 38 of 38) and may be this one; its record could not be opened (30 Oct 2026). Code ve (the Duke) is two signs v+e; Ga, Gp two signs G+a / G+p. y = 200,000 (2 cases, adopted in the retry); qA polyphonic s/i/t; 8C open.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment of DL 46150 found (28 Oct 2026 verification). The clear minute in Milan (Vestigia 194) is a draft of the same letter, not a decipherment; found after the ciphertext-only reading had reached 79% and used for the key.

conditions.human_role: The user (harrison-bornstein) fetched and supplied the Hungaricana images after the viewer and the CDN blocked automated access, and directed the sessions; no reading was supplied by a human.
tools: simulated annealing (scripts/hsolve.py, refine.py; la 4-gram from lang/)
decoders dec9-dec14 and per-round measures (scripts/dec14.py, measure14.py)
EM dynamic-programming alignment with the minute (scripts/ext/em_align.py, report.py)
Claude agents for transcription and image checks (Pillow crops)

solution.what: Read targets/buda1489 (key_R5411.md, Somogyi key, NOTES) and the verification record for catalogue 1235; planned to test key R5411 on DL 46150.

Opened the Hungaricana charter record and viewer (archives.hungaricana.hu/en/charters/view/228061/). Five images: ceteri (colour target), orig_1 (p. 1, 3668x3739), orig_2 (spread of pp. 2-3), orig_3 (p. 4), sigil. The viewer's main pane stays blank: its XHR to the tile CDN is blocked by CORS in this browser and tile URLs are encrypted client-side. Only /tile/thumb (829x512 for the spread) is reachable; no sign is legible at that size. The captcha/proof-of-work was not involved and nothing was bypassed.
Looked at the 829 px thumbnail of the pp. 2-3 spread: about 26 closely written cipher lines per page, no clear text visible; layout only.
Direct requests to the Hungaricana tile CDN answered 403; nothing bypassed.
The user fetched the three cipher images (p. 1, pp. 2-3, p. 4) from Hungaricana charter 228061 in their own browser and supplied them (kept out of git).
First session's crops, transcription and solver runs under /tmp lost in a WSL restart; redone in a persistent folder.
Pass 1 of the four pages by agents from line crops: 3,199 tokens, sign inventory.
Synthetic Latin homophonic control text of the same length and homophone structure generated (control.py) for the annealer; result not recorded.
Homophonic annealing (hsolve.py, la 4-gram, frequency penalty), several restarts: Latin fragments, no reading.
Crib reuerendissimam dominationem uestram (P1L04-05, P1L24-25): D = m, confirmed by dictum, secum, mecum.
Re-anneal with 17 crib-fixed signs (key6): reading not better.
q, g and h each read two or three letters: the labels merge shapes; pilot split of q.
Round 1: word division of all lines, strict words read 23.4%.
Shape-only split of q into qA / qB / 4 on every page by agents, without the decrypt (qA = s, qB = u).
Digraph units oH = q, Ho = p; s = h, T = b, p = x, & = et: strict 50.9%.
Split round 2 (g, oo, h, 8, 6, 3, P): gA/gB, ooA/ooB, hA/hB, 8A/8B/8C, 6A/6B; 3 and P one shape.
Rounds 3-4: restored evidence-based values, ooA = u, ooB = s, nulls dt, A, y, ff, dx, G a: strict 70.4% (several 'nulls' later proved code signs).
Rounds 5-6 image repairs by agents, changing a sign only where the image shows it (3G, jB, Tx, Ob, Bd, sl, wL, fo).
Round 6 (dec14, key14): X = ss, n context rule, polyphonic qB = u/s/f and s = h/f: strict words 79.2%, tokens 78.4%; 96% not reached.
Vestigia searched by date (vsearch.py): document 194 = ASMi Sforzesco 642, novembre no. 8, the clear minute of this letter; transcribed from its images.
EM alignment of the cipher with the minute and key rebuilt sign by sign (key from external plaintext): tokens 95.2%, minute words 81.7% agree.
Ciphertext-only work checked against the minute: key14 right on 60 of 81 signs (96.2% of tokens); blind reading 396 of 424 words = 93.4% exact; code signs had been taken as nulls, ooB as u.
41 isolated one-sign disagreements listed as transcription suspects; image check not done.
Sense measure (measure.py): 534 of 624 words read as Latin sense (85.6%; 87.3% of undamaged); reading, translation and line-by-line decryption written.

Image check of the 39 transcription suspects (shape only, 3-4x crops beside exemplars): 11 fixed in p1-p3.txt, p1r-p3r.txt and scripts/data/alignment.json (crops in transcription/checks/), 19 confirmed as written (writer departures from the minute), 9 ambiguous and left. Sense measure 534 -> 544 of 624 words (87.2%; 88.9% of undamaged).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 3108 tokens, 81 types, la-letters order 4: reading -2.14 per letter; random keys -5.566 (z 9.8); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.214 (mean -3.239, z 41.0); annealer on the real text -2.185. Verdict: pass.

Key R5407 (ASMi Sforzesco cart. 1597 no. 107, 'Cum Mafeo Triviliensi'): tried to open the DECODE record (de-crypt.org/decrypt-web/RecordsView/5407); refused by the session's network policy (proxy 403), and the DECODE cookie is not in this environment. Vestigia and Hungaricana also refused.

Key R5407 compared on the one value known from the 23 Oct 2026 contact sheet, A = ⊥: here ⊥ (L) is a in 38 of 38 aligned cases (one of three a-signs); in R5411 the same shape is h. Chance agreement for an unrelated key about 1 in 20 (3 a-signs of about 60 letter signs). Supports R5407 as this cipher's key; full comparison not possible from this session.

Retry pass (scripts/retry.py -> reading/retry.md): the 80 words left unread re-run under an extended key (values the alignment gives a sign in >= 2 other places, look-alike labels of one shape family, y as a code) and regraded C+ / M / M-slip / unexplained.

Retry results adopted in measure.py: qA polyphonic s/i/t (i in circa, ipsam, animo, additione; t in affinitatem, inter, debeat; all seven confirmed as qA on the image on 29 Oct); y = ducenta milia (200,000) at P3L02 and P3L12; cotraxerat and prefatu as spelling (nasal left out); debeat (P2L20), necessarie (P3L08) and P2L22 'neque [u]ieat a quibus haberi possit' as the cipher's own wording. 544 -> 561 of 624 words (87.2% -> 89.9%). Not adopted: 2 M (reuerendissime, responso: signs ambiguous on the image), 2 M-slip (ostendit, promiserat), 47 unexplained.

Negative control of the validation (docs/_validate.py --control --quick): the reading replaced by a key annealed onto the shuffled ciphertext scores -3.316 and is underdetermined, not a pass; the real reading passes (-2.140). Language model la-letters added to lang/ for this (Latin Library letters via raw.githubusercontent.com: Piccolomini, Poggio, Petrarch, Erasmus, Cicero), since Gutenberg (la) was unreachable.

Circularity with the Milan minute set out in NOTES ('The minute as evidence'): key.json, the exact-word measure, the suspect list, the damage fills and the retry's minority values all come from the minute, so agreement with it is not a confirmation. Independent evidence: the ciphertext-only key14 (before the minute was found) right on 60 of 81 signs, 96.2% of tokens, its reading 396 of 424 words exact; the LM validation (pass; annealer on the real ciphertext alone reaches -2.185 against -2.140 for the reading); Latin read where the minute differs or is silent (non, quoniam, debeat, neque uideat a quibus). The code-sign values rest on the minute alone.

Regrade of the read words (scripts/regrade.py -> reading/regrade.md), the doubtful-reading half of the retry step: each of the 561 read words decoded again with every value a key allows. B (key.json and the ciphertext-only key14 both give it) 466; K (key.json only) 16; X (extended qA = i/t) 7; C (code signs, meaning from the minute) 72; D (needs an emendation) 0. The crossed stretches P3L04-05 'habere uelit tantum' and P2L22 'neque ... a quibus' spell out under key values. No reading withdrawn; 466 of 624 words (74.7%) read independently of the minute.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.067; polyphony 0.021; 14 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.185

outcome.method: key recovered based on plaintext from external sources
outcome.method_basis: First a ciphertext-only break from the images (annealing, cribs, six reading rounds with image checks: 23% to 79% of words), then the clear minute of the same letter found in Milan (ASMi Sforzesco 642, Vestigia 194); the key was rebuilt by aligning the cipher with it.
outcome.fraction_read_source: measure.py -> measure.txt (30 Oct 2026, after the retry pass): 561 of 624 words of the cipher letter read as Latin sense under key.json and the extended values (exact 519, spelling 21, wording 14, added 7); not read: 8 on signs ambiguous on the image, 20 on unvalued or one-off signs, 24 no fitting word (writer departures), 12 with damage. Before the retry 544 (87.2%). Strict agreement with the minute: tokens 95.2%, words 81.7%.

outcome.notes: Read in part (89.9% of words after the retry pass of 30 Oct 2026, README bar 95%). Cipher made from the corrected minute: insertions and the marginal addition enciphered, deletions not. Ciphertext-only key14 verified at 93.4% word accuracy against the minute; the minute is the source of key.json and not an independent check of it (NOTES, circularity). Key R5407 (second Maffeo key) agrees on its one known value A = ⊥; record not reachable from the 30 Oct session.

texts.label: DL 46150, Milan 30 Nov 1490, pp. 1-4
texts.summary: Maffeo da Treviglio reports to Bishop Tamás Bakócz that Duke Gian Galeazzo Sforza welcomes the marriage alliance ('affinity') with the new king of Hungary, Vladislas II, through his sister Bianca Maria; on the dowry he moves from 150,000 to 200,000 ducats, in jewels or money, 10,000 for the bride's trousseau, and asks for envoys with a mandate or the new king's answer by the courier.

reading_review.note: Read reading/latin.md as sentences against english.md and the clear minute: coherent Latin throughout, holes marked [?word] / [...] / ⟨damage⟩ in place, densest in P1L05-L12 and P1L17 (suspect signs and title codes) and P3L15-21 (damage).

texts.note: 89.9% of words read as sense by measure.py after the retry pass (561 of 624), under the 95% bar: read in part.
